value.name: Daniel studies the memorandum
value.description: Daniel silently considers the memorandum after hearing the proposal, indicating he is weighing its implications.
evidence: Daniel was quiet. He looked at the memorandum.

value.name: Daniel looks to Rosa and his sister
value.description: Daniel shifts his attention from the memorandum to Rosa and then to his sister, showing he is considering the people involved as well as the document.
evidence: He looked at Rosa. He looked at his sister.

value.name: Daniel returns to the memorandum
value.description: Daniel finally looks back at the memorandum, suggesting continued deliberation.
evidence: He looked, finally, back at the memorandum.

value.name: Daniel declines immediate agreement
value.description: Daniel says he is not agreeing to the proposal at this moment, signaling hesitation rather than acceptance.
evidence: "I am not saying," he said, "that I would agree to that."

value.name: Rosa postpones the decision
value.description: Rosa tells Daniel he does not need to decide immediately, easing pressure on him.
evidence: "You don't have to say that today."

value.name: Daniel agrees to consider proposal
value.description: Daniel softens his stance by saying he would consider the proposal, leaving the outcome open.
evidence: "I am saying that I would consider it."
